conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDCAD is a 5y valuation extreme after the curve has already paid a large AU-over-CA 2Y premium, while AU housing is breaking and CAD still has energy ToT support.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Further AU housing/labor damage under 99th-percentile local yields while CAD activity and energy ToT stay the stronger comparable set.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: AU housing and activity re-accelerate while CAD ToT fades and the CA-AU 2Y discount reverses without AUDCAD leaving the 5y extreme.

remit: historically or fundamentally mispriced currencies and convergence trades
stance_summary: AUDCAD is the clean G10 valuation dislocation: a 5y-extreme AUD/CAD spot after the curve has already paid Australia a large 2Y premium, while the new information is Australian housing transmission and CAD energy terms-of-trade support.

catalysts: Further Australian housing, stamp-duty, or labor deterioration
Sticky energy and refined-fuel tightness that keeps CAD ToT support alive
Canadian activity/consumer follow-through after Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q
trade.invalidation: Thesis is falsified if Australian housing and activity re-accelerate while Canadian energy terms-of-trade support fades and the CA-AU 2Y discount reverses without AUDCAD leaving the 5y extreme.
trade.mispricing: AUDCAD prices Australia as the structurally superior commodity currency after the rate market has already paid a historically large AU-over-CA 2Y premium. The residual discrepancy is in the cross.
principal_risks: Negative carry of about 165bp on short AUDCAD
Saudi/Oman workaround can remove the CAD ToT anchor
No REER/PPP, no positioning/flow, no executable broker prices
Australian consumer spending may stay firm despite housing
trade.thesis: On the frozen ECB research/reference sample, AUDCAD sits at the 99.96th 5y percentile with a 5y z of +2.76 after a +1.95% 1m rise, while the CA-AU 2Y spread is already -165bp at the 10.5th 5y percentile. Spot has more than fully capitalized Australia's yield premium. Canada Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q, activity 53.2, core at target, crude-near-$110 ToT support; Australia shows housing biting under 99th-percentile local yields.
why_now: AUDCAD is at a 5y historical extreme after +1.95% in one month.
The CA-AU 2Y discount of -165bp is already in the curve; leftover mispricing lives in spot.
Australian housing evidence from 16 Sep is the new transmission.
The 18 Sep desk thesis that global tightening is broadening keeps Australian term rates elevated.
